_doc: Curated v3 overrides for the prompt-pipeline-overhaul (2026-05). Each
key is a style id; the value is a partial StyleSpecV3 payload that the
migration script merges over the auto-derived v3 fields. Only the
fields you specify here override the auto-derived ones; everything
instagram, youtube, linkedin, luxury, casual, artistic, coffee_date,
digital_nomad, travel_luxury) + headline landmarks where the v2
Trigger pools should be 3-6 equivalent formulations; the slot sampler
picks one per generation. Avoid duplicating wording across pool
entries — the more lexical diversity, the better the random sampler
